_comment: Cross-race HD aliases (Legacy Textures 0.2.5). A race with no HD files of its own borrows a donor
race's HD file at the same relative path, in HD mode, for files the race itself ships.
Player textures only, never faces; a donor file missing from the HD set leaves the race's own file.
Add or remove entries here, then press F3+T or restart. No code change.
_not_shipped: taimujin -> humansaiyan and angel -> humansaiyan were proposed and dropped in 0.2.5: their body
files are named <race>[_<form>]_<gender>_<n>_layer1..3 while the humansaiyan HD files are
bodytype_<gender>_<n>[_layer1], so not one of the 153 taimujin or 121 angel body files (DMZ Ultra
0.5.5) has a donor file at the same path. An alias for them would borrow nothing.
